periods.name: 卡邦克鲁决斗与九宝金刚杵粉碎
periods.summary: Lucifelia manipulates Carbuncle into fusing while low on magic. Monkey fights first to drain healing magic. Kinji then uses HSS, Zetsukugi and seduction/psychological pressure to shatter Nine-Jeweled Vajra and subdue Carbuncle.
periods.outcome: Carbuncle releases Hilda and Meluette, promises to sever ties with Moriarty, but is interrupted by security police friendly-fire.
